name: Search finds the source
purpose: A top-five search hit comes from a page or site that holds the answer to a factual question.
record: Cases passed over SimpleQA questions against their named source pages.
disadvantages: A right site can still be the wrong page, and answers on sources the dataset does not list are missed.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=recorded responses go through each backend adapter] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > live [sample=sample | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=network access is allowed and the provider's terms permit the queries] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the live sample did not decide]
command: esoi run search_backend --impl gemini; esoi run search_backend --impl provider; esoi run search_backend --impl searxng; esoi run search_backend --impl brave; esoi run search_backend --impl serper; esoi run search_backend --impl tavily
